description: Add a round magnifying lens at "lens" that shows a zoomed view of the area around "source". radius defaults to about 8% of the short side of the image under the source.

lens.description: A point. Canvas coordinates, or image pixels when relativeTo is set.

relativeTo.description: Image id from snipaya_get_canvas. When set, all coordinates in this call are pixels of that image as captured (the same pixels you see in snipaya_render of that image).

source.description: A point. Canvas coordinates, or image pixels when relativeTo is set.

style.description: Optional style. Omitted fields use the user’s current tool style. Brand colors: coral #EC534E, papaya #FE9440.

tabId.description: Target tab id. Defaults to the active tab.

name: snipaya_add_magnifier
title: Add magnifier
